about: Northern English (Yorkshire/Lancashire-ish), from the ROADMAP step 1 listening test. Non-rhotic, so R marks are ignored. t' for 'the' and unstressed -in (heard best, 2026-11-23); h dropped only in words without primary stress (he, his, her, had; 2026-11-23), dropping it everywhere was overdone. FACE stays A before a sentence end: eː there grew a tail ('normalé.' heard as 'normahlet').
